scenes.trigger: The playing track changes, or Home loads with a last-played track in state
scenes.feedback: The ambient field behind the hero cross-fades to a tint derived from the new cover; text and the violet primary do not move or change colour
scenes.interrupt: A second track change mid-fade retargets the same field rather than stacking a second layer
scenes.reducedMotion: Tint is applied instantly with no cross-fade; no other behaviour changes

scenes.trigger: Tap the mini player, or start a track from any surface
scenes.feedback: The mini player artwork scales into the overlay hero position instead of the overlay cutting in over it
scenes.interrupt: Collapse or a downward gesture reverses the same transform back into the mini player; playback is never touched
scenes.reducedMotion: The overlay appears with no transform, exactly the current hidden-attribute behaviour

scenes.trigger: Home scrolls until the hero's top edge passes under the sticky header
scenes.feedback: The sticky header carries no fill and no rule while the top of the wash is behind it, so the light reads as coming from one place instead of being cut off by a band across the screen; the fill returns as the hero's top edge passes it
scenes.interrupt: Scrolling back up restores transparency at the same threshold; there is no snap point and playback is untouched
scenes.reducedMotion: The 200ms fill fade is the only easing and nothing moves, so the scene is already within a reduced-motion budget; the state change itself still happens because it is contrast, not decoration
scenes.notes: Implemented on the sticky header rather than the bottom tab bar: on a phone the tab bar is at the opposite end of the screen from the hero and never overlaps the wash, so translucency there would have been decoration with no function - and the brand recipe rejects glass imitation.
